rumahlabuh_landing_page.position: Too slow for mobile users. Should implement ISR and lazy load images.

over_engineering.position: Adding complexity before validating the problem is almost always wrong.

legion_slash_commands.position: 100+ slash commands is a UX failure. Intent routing should replace most of them.

pytorch_vs_tensorflow.position: PyTorch wins for research. TensorFlow only makes sense for specific production pipelines at scale.

transformer_pose_models.position: Transformer-based pose models will overtake CNN pipelines within 2 years. FiLM conditioning is the right approach for multi-task learning.

supabase_rls.position: Supabase is genuinely good. The RLS system is underused — most developers skip it and regret it later.

thesis_timing.position: A thesis that ships on time beats a perfect one submitted late. Scope cut > delay.

bashara_facts.project: Data Science MSc thesis — human pose estimation with PyTorch
